mapper.select: SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.RENTAL_ID DESC

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND R.GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND R.GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND R.USER_ID = 'GUEST'

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId}
SELECT EXTENSION_ID, EXTENSION_DAYS, PRICE, CREATED_AT, RENTAL_ID FROM RENTAL_EXTENSION WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RENTAL_EXTENSION ( EXTENSION_DAYS, PRICE, CREATED_AT, RENTAL_ID ) VALUES ( #{extensionDays}, #{price}, NOW(), #{rentalId} )
